purpose: First qualification of the actual CI release binaries, not host-rebuilt substitutes.
selection: Exact independently hashed glibc x86_64 wheel from each reviewed seven-platform set; SDK wheel hash must match before installation.
sampling: Existing robust preset, fixed state-age windows, complete raw observations; unchanged GC and ABBA order.
repeat_policy: One declared shipping-artifact run; no favorable resampling or excluded tails.

prior_host_build_run.reason_not_shipping_evidence: Its host-built companion wheels are not the published matrix binaries.
prior_host_build_run.retention: Complete original raw samples, logs, manifests and artifact hashes retained separately.
